title: Position: Measure Dataset Diversity, Don’t Just Claim It

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and qualitative coding of 135 image and text datasets to evaluate how they conceptualize, operationalize, and validate diversity and bias claims using principles from measurement theory.

A case study analyzing the Segment Anything (SA-1B) dataset to evaluate how it conceptualizes and operationalizes geographic diversity and socioeconomic status (e.g., using Named Entity Recognition for location and World Bank income levels).

Analysis of how human subject diversity is defined and measured across surveyed datasets, highlighting methodological pitfalls like the reification of binary gender categories and the subjective operationalization of race versus skin tone.
